literal: Glorious wound not-received days all, among wasted days, he will place, his own days taking and counting.
translation: When a warrior counts the days of his life, he will reckon all those days on which he did not receive a glorious wound in battle as wasted days.
modern: ஒரு வீரன் தன் வாழ்நாட்களைக் கணக்கிட்டுப் பார்க்கும் போது, தன் மார்பில் சிறந்த வீரப்புண் படாத நாட்களை எல்லாம் வீணான நாட்களின் பட்டியலில் சேர்ப்பான்.
explanation: This couplet illustrates the extreme valor and pride of a warrior. A true hero measures the value of his life not by its length, but by the battles fought and the honorable wounds sustained. When he reviews his past, taking and counting his days, he considers any day without a glorious wound on his chest as a wasted day or a failure. The word 'vazhukku' refers to a slip or fault, here used to mean a day spent in vain without heroic action.
